A traditional war '''masks''' was worn by [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]], later known as [[General/Legends|General]] Grievous. One [[Helmet/Legends|mask]] was carved from a [[Mumuu/Legends|mumuu]]<ref name="The Story of General Grievous" /> [[Bone/Legends|skull]]<ref name="TNEGD" /> and bone<ref name="Starships & Vehicles 27" /> originally worn by his late [[Grievous's father/Legends|father]],<ref name="The Story of General Grievous" /> while another one was made from the bone of [[Karabbac/Legends|karabbac]].<ref name="Starships & Vehicles 27" />
